data.description: Read-only access to a factory parts catalogue: vehicles, exploded drawings, part numbers, fitment, supersessions and prices.

caveats.no_quantities: The catalogue records which parts a vehicle takes, never how many. Every part carries "quantity": null and that is the true value.
caveats.prices: List prices exist for the Japanese dataset only, in whole yen, with no history.
caveats.unresolved_hotspots: About 18% of drawing callouts point at standard fasteners that appear in no parts list; they carry "resolved": false.
caveats.notes_scope: Illustration notes are per catalogue, not per figure — no key in the source data ties one to a single drawing reliably.
caveats.unverified_fields: Fields under an "unverified" key are read from the record layout but confirmed by no published legend.
caveats.opaque_spec_codes: Spec/option codes are surrogate identifiers and cannot be translated.
